about: The user's fourth playtest, request 24 (decisions DH-115 to DH-121; Book 9 section 03, "Chapter 1 finds"; Book 10 section 20): one or two small points of interest in each Chapter 1 zone, each off the obvious path, drawn as a prop of prop_finds, found with Interact. A TAKE is picked up (its glint goes and its taken frame stays); a READ is looked at, and can be again. What each gives is Book 10's ("Chapter 1 finds", by balanceKey). Positions are in tiles of the zone, at the foot.

finds.about: In the wrack of the far west beach, past the end of the shingle the opening walks: a walk north along the shore from the wreck's chest, never on the way to anything
In the blind gully east of the stream's mouth, a pocket of shingle under the bank that leads nowhere; the gull on it lifts as the steerer comes
A fallen slab in the long grass of the north-west machair, far off the line from the broch to the Hag's Seat
A small cairn on the north-east rise, looking out to sea; nothing in Chapter 1 takes the steerer there
In a cleft on the headland's northern tongue, north of the Hag's Stone and away from the path to it, over the drop to the sea
On the mound's far, eastern flank, out of sight of the fold and the way north to the cove
On a ledge at the cove's northern tip, west of the cave mouth, where the shingle runs out under the bank
Wedged in the rocks at the cove's southern end, the far end of the shingle from the cave
